rules_are: assistant synthesis, not independently reproduced protocols

routes.choose_when_inferred: Known catalytic geometry; explicit backbone motif enumeration
routes.workflow_inferred: Generate scaffold, design sequence, refold, evaluate reaction-state ensembles
routes.limits: Probe labelling and single acylation are not sustained turnover

routes.choose_when_inferred: Functional atom geometry known; residue positions and unspecified atoms free
routes.workflow_inferred: Generate around atomic motif; sequence and global/local structure screening
routes.limits: Check metal competition, substrate placement and metal dependence

routes.choose_when_inferred: Experimentally active parent with identifiable geometric defect
routes.workflow_inferred: Rebuild selected region and compare activity to parent
routes.limits: Do not report parent-derived hit rates as independent de novo success

routes.choose_when_inferred: Catalytic geometry plus compatible scaffold library
routes.workflow_inferred: Match geometry, redesign pocket, test catalysis
routes.limits: Scaffold may prevent essential backbone interactions

routes.workflow_inferred: Train, propose variants, measure and update
routes.limits: Separate expression effects from intrinsic catalysis

routes.choose_when_inferred: Expression or stability is limiting; structure and homologs available
routes.workflow_inferred: Design stability variants and remeasure activity
routes.limits: Not new-reaction design; use corrected supplemental scripts; experimental and execution audits remain partial

routes.workflow_inferred: Install cofactor, adapt protein environment, evolve
Condition generation on family and assay products
Infer ancestors, test stability and function
routes.limits: Author abstract supports selected examples of robustness and activity; no universal benefit or novel-chemistry claim. Full methods and ancestral uncertainty remain pending.
input_contract_inferred: Phylogenetic model and target ancestral node
output_contract_inferred: Separate stability, specific activity and substrate-panel measurements

routes.route: Generated scaffold library and active-site matching
routes.choose_when_inferred: Pocket-bearing fold family is available, but native scaffold diversity is insufficient
routes.workflow_inferred: Generate scaffold library, dock catalytic interaction fields, redesign sequences, screen and optimize
routes.limits: Fold-family bias and large experimental library; separate initial hits from optimized performance

routes.choose_when_inferred: Existing enzyme supports desired chemistry but does not accept target substrate
routes.workflow_inferred: Use substrate analogs and modeling to establish target activity, then evolve under relevant process constraints
routes.limits: Weak starting activity and final manufacturing performance belong to distinct stages; process productivity is not intrinsic enzyme kinetics

routes.choose_when_inferred: Reaction-state geometry and atom-level ligand/environment constraints are available
routes.workflow_inferred: Condition generation on catalytic motif and ligand exposure; design sequences and evaluate relevant reaction states
routes.limits: E014 selected methods checked; E017 campaign-specific version remains unverified; do not treat mixed papers as controlled model comparison

routes.choose_when_inferred: Desired chemistry benefits from a catalytic group outside standard amino acids
routes.workflow_inferred: Introduce the catalytic group in a protein environment and optimize by design/evolution
routes.limits: Abstract-level evidence here; incorporation, occupancy, free-catalyst controls and assay details need full-text verification
